Its composition block carries routing { method: in-loop, version } and definitionHash after flowsStatement; its trace carries one load span (tool.operation_type load_source, tool.load_outcome loaded) and one Socrata data call.

WHERE THE BYTES COME FROM. This repository's own code: buildInLoopRecord() in src/in-loop-golden.test.ts derives the record from literal inputs with an injected clock and id source, and produce-core assembles it. No reference capture exists for an in-loop run, so the test also asserts the record's structure (one server agent, one dataSources entry, the load activity on the platform agent, the block's key order).
